text_block_list.text:
Эль Кондор Паса participates in the
summer
festival during camp.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
While the other Umamusume tire out
and take a
break to rest, Эль Кондор Паса
continues dancing
alone to entertain
everyone.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
In doing so, she finally understands what
Silence
Suzuka meant about El Condor
Pasa possessing a
special power.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Her victories and performances are all
for the
sake of making people happy. To
that end, she'll
do her best no matter
the circumstances. That's
her true power.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Эль Кондор Паса's dream is to entertain
everyone.
Together, we offer a prayer to
her mask, the
symbol of her dreams.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
